page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top with page number at top right. No margin notes. Main text runs top to bottom, with a centred chapter heading and a small two-column list of diphthongs with Greek examples.

p.i: sonorum imitatio ex abusu corruptæ lin-guæ nata videatur: ut proferendæ singulæ sint pro sua potestate.

main_text.p: Græcarum verò literarum numerus priùs haberi jam olim solitus est, quàm per genera & species dividi, & quidem hac generum confusione:
Α β γ δ ε ζ η θ ι κ λ μ ν ξ ο π ρ σ τ υ φ χ ψ ω. unde numerandi notæ factæ sunt.
main_text.head: Cap. 2. De Diphthongo.
main_text.p: υι est in paucis, ut ὑπνια harpuia: sic ὁπτάω, in matrimonio habeo.

page.notes: Greek words in the list and the final line are printed with accents and breathings that are partly worn; the Greek forms are transcribed as best read. The Greek alphabet line and the diphthong examples are uncertain in places. The word "harpuia" and the Greek after it are doubtful.
